summary: Strategic Chief of Staff and AI Transformation Lead (Senior Manager) reporting directly to the Executive Vice President of Cloud & Custom Apps (C&CA) India. Converts leadership priorities into enterprise-grade operating systems across large-scale business units. Uniquely bridges operational strategy (workforce supply chain, rotations governance, forecasting, utilization) with advanced AI transformation (adaptive assessment platforms, voice-interview agents, prompt optimization, and AI-native client delivery). roles.title: Chief of Staff & AI Transformation Lead — Cloud & Custom Apps (C&CA India)
roles.scope_note: Serve as Chief of Staff to the EVP, running the strategic execution and industrialization office of a large-scale developer division. Drive a multi-workstream transformation portfolio across workforce supply chain, rotation governance, forecasting, KPI models, reporting hubs, and GenAI/AI adoption across a multi-account enterprise portfolio.
achievements: CHIEF OF STAFF OPERATIONS: Convert leadership priorities into robust enterprise operating systems (playbooks, KPI trackers, governance cadences, custom portals) to drive execution and delivery discipline across a large-scale business unit.

AI TRANSFORMATION & CLIENT ADVISORY: Partner with account engagement managers to analyze client automation frameworks (e.g., auditing order-to-cash workflows for a major US retailer); triaged solutions to distinguish simple AI-assisted process automation from multi-agent orchestration, scaling high-impact success stories across the account portfolio.

ADAPTIVE ASSESSMENT ENGINE (AAT): Envisioned and designed the business logic for the Adaptive Assessment Tool (AAT) to support workforce learning pathways. Built a CAT-level adaptive MCQ engine that scales question difficulty in real-time and provides cohort dashboards to optimize L&D pedagogy, successfully cutting recertification failure rates for expensive external badges from 20% to under 5%.

BOTP COMPLIANCE & COST MITIGATION: Integrated Back On Track Performance (BOTP) compliance tracking into the AAT platform, providing legally robust, automated documentation of low-performing profiles to streamline exit management and save millions in salary overhead.

TALENTX CO-CREATION: Co-envisioned TalentX, an AI voice-interview platform that evaluates candidates by transcribing recorded voice answers and generating dynamic, context-aware follow-up questions from the JD and resume. Designed granular scoring scorecards and visual skill trees to slash panel interview volumes and subjective feedback loops.

WORKFORCE SUPPLY CHAIN & TALENT FACTORY: Co-developed the C&CA India build-vs-buy talent strategy (70% upskill-and-deploy / 30% targeted hiring) and structured learning pathways across 5 key domains (Developers, Software Engineers, SMEs, AI Native Engineers, Architects/EMs) to transition I-shaped developers into multi-disciplinary T-shaped software engineers.

ROTATION & SUCCESSION GOVERNANCE: Governed rotation execution across a multi-account portfolio against a 16% external rotation target — designed transparent tenure-based calculation logic, account-level scorecards, and a SharePoint-automated Succession & Rotations Dashboard, delivering 637 rotations.

CHRYSALIS TALENT PORTAL: Managed the Chrysalis operating model, building an end-to-end portal for hire estimation, project allocation, and performance transparency; grew B-School talent pool billability from 30% to 60% and reduced requirement-gathering cycle time by 80% via the custom portal.

FORECASTING & KPI GOVERNANCE: Converted business unit KPIs into program-specific success metrics; improved forecasting hygiene by defining roles/windows and linking Talent Fulfillment validation to sold/pursuit demands.

DATABASES & REPORTING PLATFORMS: Drove the rehaul of reporting systems (CCAReports, Account Matrix 1.0/2.0, Smart Insights) to combine utilization, demand-supply, and revenue forecasting into a single operational view.

COMMUNITIES & ADVOCACY: Shaped EM, GenAI, Architect, and Industry community structures — strategy, certification programs, and a content-generation KM portal; launched a central quarterly newsletter to a wide subscriber base (tens of thousands) and drove a 50% increase in professional certifications within one year.

AI FINOPS & OBSERVED OPTIMIZATION: Led prompt/token optimization thinking (e.g., routing/tiered models reducing token burn from 11,700 to 3,000 tokens), semantic caching, RAG retrieval optimization, and four-layer token observability; advocated for Claude Certified Architect foundations certification.

TEAM LEADERSHIP & ORG DESIGN: Managed 4 direct reports and oversaw 15 indirect contributors; led 4 Chrysalis talents handling governance for leadership while grooming 4 more, designing the role-based operating structures (org chart, ownership maps, workflows) they work within.
